assumptions: The scan indexing constraint is stated, not assumed away: the loop reads the scan inline array for logical indices <= 7 and the scan heap array at index - 8 above that, with total = scan heap length + scan extra count; inputs violating that addressing (a short inline array, or a heap too short for the total) are model guard errors, because the native code reads those locations without a check.
The collection inline base and heap arrays are modelled as lists; their capacity fields are modelled only through the heap capacity number, which the recompute retains across its heap clear.
The native zero-new-capacity growth arm requires a nonempty heap of size 0 and is unreachable for a well-formed heap; it is not modelled beyond the length-error guard.
The recompute's incoming rsi (the setter's new value) is never read: the recompute works from the stored threshold field, which the setter writes before tail-jumping.

The direct caller of the setter (site 0x5d67f16) and the direct caller of the recompute inside the 0x5f7e420 function (site 0x5f7eba1) are recorded as sites only; their surrounding functions are not modelled here.

0x5f6c082.rule: element value < threshold (unsigned) -> append record to collection; otherwise minimum update

0x5f6c089.rule: element value < threshold is the append branch above (jb from the threshold compare)

0x5f6c0d7.rule: collection size > 7 -> heap append path; otherwise inline append path

0x5f6c129.rule: heap end == heap cap end -> grow path; otherwise direct heap append

0x5f6c27b.rule: stored threshold field < new value (unsigned) -> tail-jump to recompute; otherwise return

semantics.collection_append: size <= 7 stores at the inline base + size * 16; past that, stores at the heap end when below the heap cap end, otherwise grows the heap (capacity 1 when empty, else twice the heap size capped at 0x7ffffffffffffff elements) and stores.
semantics.fast_path: store the new value at +0xf30, then return without rescanning when the new value is <= the old minimum (unsigned); the collection and minimum then still reflect the previous threshold.
semantics.minimum: smallest scanned element value >= threshold (unsigned), or the sentinel 0x00ffffffffffffff when no scanned value qualifies.
semantics.recompute_entry: collection size := 0 when nonzero; heap end := heap begin when they differ (capacity retained); minimum := sentinel.
semantics.scan: total = scan heap length + scan extra count; index <= 7 reads the scan inline array, index > 7 reads the scan heap array at index - 8; per record, skip when the flag byte is nonzero or the value is zero; value < threshold appends the whole 16-byte record, otherwise it is a minimum candidate.
semantics.setter: store new value at +0xf30; tail-jump to the recompute when the old minimum is unsigned-less than the new value, else return.
